structure.unit: Virginia Birth-Related Neurological Injury Compensation Act

law.catch_line: Enforcement, etc., of orders and awards
law.text: The Commission has full authority to enforce its orders and protect itself from deception. While the language of this section is permissive and provides that a party may enforce an award in court, it must be read and considered in pari materia with the Commission's power pursuant to § 65.2-202 to punish for disobedience of its orders.
